costSensitivity.method: Equal-weight family means; paired family bootstrap, 95% interval. Describes these cases, not guaranteed production performance.
costSensitivity.unit: candidate minus baseline provider-reported total tokens per task; not billed cost
costSensitivity.note: Exploratory interval, not a post-hoc promotion rule. Cost gate was the predeclared point saving of 2%; the utility gate uses a paired family interval.

limitations: Final role instructions are longer: 85 words versus 36; combined custom instructions 269 versus 220. The measured gain is in full workflow tokens, not instruction compression.
Provider total tokens include cached input and reported output/reasoning. Requested priority was reported as default; timing is descriptive. Unreported partial transport cost is not measurable.

Native hosted-search action metadata is visible, underlying fetched body/status is not. The first confirmation retained four inaccessible-URL answers as partial rather than claiming their 502 details verified.

First confirmation repaired stale SDK error flags after three successful retries and applied the existing production empty-citation renderer; original traces and hashes were preserved. Later runner directly records retries and rendering.

Final reviews used two immutable packets containing all scheduled trials per repeat; records were verified identical to the complete run before merging. Three malformed-ID grader batches were preserved; two missing reviews were completed by the primary agent under the same policy.

Final audit retained all three baseline citation-token defects, missing citations, an inaccurate date-order example, an underspecified Set explanation, an overconfident join inference, and four wrong skill-relative-path attempts across both variants.
Only researcher configuration is validated. No shared-base, suggestion, reviewer, coordinator, session, or general skill rewrite is authorized by these results.
Exposed confirmation sets are now regression cases. New promotion requires genuinely fresh families and a new frozen manifest.
